BiblicalUsage: tsôwm is the Bible's word for a fast. In 2 Samuel 12:16, David fasted, and went in. Wherever it appears, the word means this and not something vaguer.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that fasting is not a way to earn God's ear; it is the outward sign of a heart that is already listening. That is why I hold tsôwm fast when easier words tempt me away.
